verses.english: The faculties of the eye, ear, nose, tongue, body, and mind.

verses.pali: Yato kho, bhikkhave, ariyasāvako imesaṁ channaṁ indriyānaṁ samudayañca atthaṅgamañca assādañca ādīnavañca nissaraṇañca yathābhūtaṁ pajānāti—
verses.english: A noble disciple comes to truly understand these six faculties’ origin, disappearance, gratification, drawback, and escape.

verses.pali: ayaṁ vuccati, bhikkhave, ariyasāvako sotāpanno avinipātadhammo niyato sambodhiparāyaṇo”ti.
verses.english: Such a noble disciple is called a stream-enterer, not liable to be reborn in the underworld, assured, destined for awakening.”
